card.name: Drug-name words before a following noun
card.fires_on: Fires on the last piece of a drug or drug-class phrase, such as "drugs" after antipsychotic, "plus" in CE plus MPA, or the middle of a name like penicillamine. It sits where the next word is another drug, therapy or arm name.

modes.label: Class word after drug group
modes.description: The word "drugs" right after a drug class such as antipsychotic.
modes.example: immediate discontinuation of antipsychotic<< drugs>> and other drugs not essential to concurrent therapy

modes.label: Plus in combination therapy
modes.description: The word "plus" joining two drugs in a treatment arm or comparison.
modes.example: for CE<< plus>> MPA versus placebo was 2.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a long drug name, before the rest of the name.
modes.example: has been reported with penic<<ill>>amine capsules

card.writes: No clear link to the output; the promoted tokens are unrelated and it mildly suppresses injection and spray words.
card.plain: It marks the point in a drug phrase where another drug or treatment name is about to follow.
